name: code-cycle-toolkit
description: Portable Code Cycle skills for implementing work items from GitHub, Plane, or Jira, reviewing pull requests on GitHub or Bitbucket, and verifying the result.

interface.longDescription: A portable collection of skills for implementing work items from GitHub, Plane, or Jira, reviewing pull requests on GitHub or Bitbucket, resolving findings, rereviewing changes, and coordinating the full cycle. It bundles the review, security, verification, and run passes those workflows delegate to. Orca orchestration is optional.
defaultPrompt: Implement issue 123 and open a pull request.
Review pull request 456 and publish the findings.
Run the complete Code Cycle for issue 123.
